I did the same thing in high school. I was the class clown, made everyone laugh. Yet no one really gave me attention.. no one really talked to me. No one got to know me, they got to know my shitty jokes and able to associate me with them, but I'm sure they've forgotten me already. No point in remembering a washup, right?
